name: Northern Rivers Gateway
summary: Lismore/Northern Rivers NSW regional ISP (Northern Rivers Gateway, NRG; nrg.com.au live by 1997); ran later as NRG Internet; in the Nornet/Linear G group from ~2001, brand folded into LinearG Jan 2009.

events.details: Northern Rivers regional ISP. Live by 1997.
Nornet's site states the Modulux/Nornet group had NRG under its umbrella 'since 2001'; the NRG Internet brand and nrg.com.au kept operating until the domain began redirecting to linearg.com.

refs.label: Nornet (Wayback 25 Jul 2013): 'Since 2001, Modulux pty ltd have under its umbrella ... Lismore's NRG (Northern Rivers Gateway)'

events.details: NRG Internet brand folded into the group; nrg.com.au first archived redirecting to nor.com.au 23 Jan 2009 (Nornet itself folded into linearg.com Dec 2014).
